req.title: Task description accepts long text
req.statement: The system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters. This necessitates testing for valid inputs within this limit, invalid inputs exceeding this limit, and boundary conditions around the specified limit to ensure robustness and compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_long_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
The database is initialized and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task description of exactly 1000 characters.
expected: The response contains the task with the correct description length.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

description = 'x' * 1000  # 1000 characters long
data = {"title": "Test Task", "description": description, "completed": False}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["description"] == description

tests.name: test_create_task_with_excessive_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
The database is initialized and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task description of 1001 characters.
expected: The response status code is 422 indicating unprocessable entity.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

description = 'x' * 1001  # 1001 characters long
data = {"title": "Test Task", "description": description, "completed": False}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=data)
assert response.status_code == 422
